name: Icon Explorer
tagline: Icon Previewer for Artists and Developers
blurb: Icon Explorer allows artists and developers to preview and pick icons.
description:
Icon Explorer allows artists and developers to preview and pick icons. Icon Explorer attempts to render the icons exactly as they would look drawn in the application. It allows to filter based on category and name. Icon Explorer is not a general-purpose tool, but geared towards artists' and developers' use-cases.
Icon Explorer also provides a plugin for Kate and KDevelop to be used as icon picker.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
